packaged survival meal.definition: a non rotting food, rare on the rimworld, very useful

saguaro cactus.definition: a large cactus found in desert regions

Wander_OwnRoom.definition: a mental break where a pawn wanders around their own room, often due to stress or discomfort

BloodLoss.definition: a lifethreatening condition where a pawn loses a significant amount of blood

Malnutrition.definition: a condition resulting from insufficient intake of nutrients. Potentially fatal when severe

hunter drone.definition: an ancient autonomous drone with a deadly melee attack. Found in ancient complexes, not raids.

saguaros cactus.definition: a large cactus found in desert regions

drago tree.definition: a subtropical tree, capable of growing in dry conditions

agave.definition: a wild fruit that grows in bushes, useful as nutrition

horseshoe pin.definition: the most basic form of recreation on the Rimworld. Players throw horseshoes at a distance to a stick

drop pod.definition: a single use rocket powered pod that can carry humans or items

glitterworld.definition: a distant utopia world with extremely advanced technology

agave fruit.definition: a wild fruit that grows in bushes, useful as nutrition

ancient security terminal.definition: a terminal found in ancient complexes, that control a turret or a door

sleeping spot.definition: a designated spot on the floor where to sleep on. Not comfortable

chain shotgun.definition: A fully automatic shotgun. Very deadly at close range

component.definition: a crucial crafting item required for most electrical buildings. Very important for the colony

ancient defender turret.definition: a dangerous turret found in ancient complexes. Not part of raids.

LuciferiumAddiction.definition: an addiction to luciferium, gained after a single dose, permanent

LuciferiumHigh.definition: a mood bonus from ingesting luciferium

ancient security turret.definition: a dangerous turret found in ancient complexes. Not part of raids.

luciferium.definition: the most potent drug. Permanent addiction from a single dose

Mechanoid.definition: A very dangerous robotlike enemy, armed with dangerous energy weapons

sighstealer.definition: a terrifying creature that appears invisible until it attacks. Black and inhuman.

gorehulk.definition: A massive humanlike monster with long spikes in it's back. It attacks by hurling spikes at the enemy.

thrumbo.definition: A massive white animal, armed with a razorsharp horn. Incredibly dangerous when provoked but normally friendly. The horn and it's fur is valuable.

wasp.definition: an ancient defender drone that stings with a razor sharp sting. Dangerous

locust.definition: a large insect capable of flying. Dangerous

megascarab.definition: a large insect with sharp prongs. Dangerous

ghoul.definition: A terrifying greyish humanlike entity capable of only violence. Eats only meat, and can be utilized in colony defence if fed properly.

harbinger tree.definition: A mysterious tree made from flesh.

void monolith.definition: A mysterious black monolith that pulses with horrifying energy. It can be studied to gain access to morbid technologies.

waster.definition: a human xenotype. grey skin, innate dependence on drugs and immunity to toxicity.

reinforced barrel.definition: a rare and valuable barrel used in mortars and cannons. Cannot be manufactured and are a scarce appliance

yattakin.definition: a human xenotype with furry skin and profiency in animal handling and melee.

void.definition: an allencompassing entity that sends horrifying threats to the colony.
